description.zh:
时间排序。取值：
- true（默认值）：表示时间倒序。
- false：表示时间正序。
description.en:
The order of alerts. Valid values:

- true (default value): reverse chronological order

- false: chronological order

description.zh:
查询报警历史的结束时间戳。

单位：毫秒。
description.en:
The end timestamp of the historical alerts that you want to query.

Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh:
应用分组ID。

关于如何获取应用分组ID，请参见[DescribeMonitorGroups](~~115032~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the application group.

For information about how to obtain the ID of an application group, see [DescribeMonitorGroups](~~115032~~).

description.zh:
云产品的监控项名称。

关于如何查询云产品的监控项名称，请参见[云产品监控项](~~163515~~)。
description.en:
The metric that is used to monitor the cloud service.

For information about how to query the name of a metric, see [Appendix 1: Metrics](~~163515~~).

description.zh:
云产品的数据命名空间。

关于如何查询云产品的数据命名空间，请参见[云产品监控项](~~163515~~)。
description.en:
The namespace of the cloud service.

For information about how to query the namespace of a cloud service, see [Appendix 1: Metrics](~~163515~~).

The number of the page to return.

Default value: 1.

description.zh:
每页显示记录条数。

默认值：10。
description.en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Default value: 10.

description.zh:
报警规则ID。

关于如何查询报警规则ID，请参见[DescribeMetricRuleList](~~114941~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the alert rule.

For information about how to obtain the ID of an alert rule, see [DescribeMetricRuleList](~~114941~~).

description.zh:
报警规则名称。

关于如何查询报警规则名称，请参见[DescribeMetricRuleList](~~114941~~)。
description.en:
The name of the alert rule.

For information about how to query the name of an alert rule, see [DescribeMetricRuleList](~~114941~~).

description.zh:
查询报警历史的开始时间戳。

单位：毫秒。
description.en:
The start timestamp of the historical alerts that you want to query.

Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh:
报警状态。取值：
- ALARM（默认值）：报警状态。
- OK：正常状态。
description.en:
The status of the alert. Valid values:

- ALARM (default value): Alerts are triggered.

- OK: No alerts are triggered.

description.zh:
通道沉默状态。取值：
- 2（默认值）：通道沉默。
- 0：报警或恢复。
- 1：失效期。
description.en:
Specifies whether alerts are muted. Valid values:

- 2 (default value): Alerts are muted and are not triggered within the mute period, even if the condition specified in the alert rule is met.

- 0: Alerts are triggered or cleared.

- 1: The alert rule is ineffective.

descriptions.en: This API operation is no longer maintained. We recommend that you call the [DescribeAlertLogList](~~201087~~) operation.
